ambiguity.detail: Unclear why the manor doctor refused the village boy.

verdict.hook_line: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
verdict.cliffhanger_line: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A compassionate healer deals with medical neglect among the poor while wealthy elites plot murders.
verdict.why_it_works: Juxtaposes the raw desperation of the peasantry against the cold luxury of the villains.
